verdict.rationale: Dagster publishes a pricing page with at least one concrete tier price (Solo Plan at $10 per month with a 30-day free trial), so the pricing model is publicly published. Nothing in the evidence explains how costs scale with usage, or how to estimate what adding a new source would cost before connecting it. missing for 10: description of the usage/metering model (e.g., per-asset or per-run charges), a per-source cost estimation method or calculator, details of other tiers and overage behavior, and independent corroboration that costs are predictable.

support.subject: As a data platform lead, the pricing model is published and predictable — I can estimate what a new source costs before connecting it
